name: Spec Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/spec/SPEC.md exists and states a size class S, M or L with the rule that produced it
Every requirement has an id REQ-nnn and names an acceptance eval id EVAL-nnn
Every NFR budget value carries a source URL with read date, or is [OPEN] with the person who can answer it
docs/architecture/spec/tasks.md exists and every task traces to at least one REQ-nnn
An S-class spec is at most 60 lines, so its size matches the change
notes: Right-sizing is the answer to the over-specification failure Boeckeler documents for Kiro and Spec Kit (docs/research/leadership-benchmarks.md section B).
